A couple of clarifications:

- For KMS: a one-page diagram and a short attestation line we can include in our CAIQ responses (e.g., "Redwood uses customer-isolated KMS with ephemeral data keys; master keys are rotated every X days").
- DPA: Yes, we will accept a short DPA clause via DocuSign.

If you can get the manifest and narratives on Mon, we can let procurement know DocuSign will follow. Thanks — Pete
